entry_point.discipline_context: Use potential energy, equilibrium, and numerical relaxation to motivate an optimisation landscape.
entry_point.rationale: Second-year mechanical engineers can connect a downhill search direction with reducing a scalar energy-like objective before formalising the mathematics.
entry_point.analogy_boundary: The energy picture is a teaching analogy: the canonical formulation is an arbitrary differentiable objective, so no physical interpretation is assumed unless stated.

chapter_sequence.title: From equilibrium to an optimisation problem
chapter_sequence.purpose: Introduce the unconstrained problem and first- and second-order conditions through a careful potential-energy analogy.

chapter_sequence.title: Smoothness, convexity, and conditioning
chapter_sequence.purpose: Define smoothness, the Descent Lemma, convexity, strong convexity, Hessian characterisations, and condition number.

chapter_sequence.title: Gradient descent and choosing a step
chapter_sequence.purpose: State gradient descent, constant steps, exact line search, and Armijo backtracking.

chapter_sequence.title: What convergence guarantees actually say
chapter_sequence.purpose: Present convex and strongly convex rates, Heavy Ball, and the specified NAG recurrence and rate.

chapter_sequence.title: Stochastic and adaptive gradient methods
chapter_sequence.purpose: Explain the finite-sum stochastic model, SGD assumptions and step regimes, AdaGrad, RMSProp, and Adam.

chapter_sequence.title: Second-order optimisation
chapter_sequence.purpose: Introduce Newton and BFGS with their implementation details and local convergence scope.

chapter_sequence.title: Exercises and worked solutions
chapter_sequence.purpose: Consolidate theorem scope, one gradient update, and a Python diagnosis in a final chapter.

implementation_strategy: Use executable NumPy code to connect current-iterate gradients, signs, indices, and outputs to the mathematical updates.
assessment_strategy: Use exactly three final worked exercises: one concept check, one unified objective-gradient-update calculation, and one executable code diagnostic.

exercise_plan.learning_objective: Distinguish stationarity, second-order conditions, and theorem scope in an equilibrium-style optimisation statement.
exercise_plan.discipline_context: Assess a claimed equilibrium of a reduced potential-energy model for a linkage.

exercise_plan.learning_objective: Apply gradient descent and verify one objective-gradient-update chain.
exercise_plan.discipline_context: Take one relaxation step for a two-parameter quadratic calibration objective.

exercise_plan.learning_objective: Diagnose a sign error and connect a corrected NumPy loop to current-iterate gradient descent.
exercise_plan.discipline_context: Inspect a short NumPy relaxation loop for a quadratic stiffness-fitting objective.
